item.title: Emergency radio network and disability charities among latest AJC grant recipients
item.description: AN EMERGENCY radio network and a disability charity are among the latest charities to have benefited from grant funding. item.title: A big one for the Island
item.description: THE Government has just published the latest data on the Island’s population, something which in previous years would have provided much fertile material for prospective election candidates. item.title: Romanian nationals urged to complete survey
item.description: ROMANIAN nationals have been encouraged to fill in a survey to encourage a touring consulate to visit Jersey in 2026. item.title: Demand on police “consistently high” and rising
item.description: DEMAND on the States police “remains consistently high” and is expected to rise, according to the force’s latest policing plan. item.title: Court hears from third woman who claims she was raped as a teenager

item.title: Domestic abuser jailed after assaults against woman
item.description: A MAN has been convicted of assault and domestic abuse at the end of a week-long trial. item.title: Finding room: Reducing pressure by housing our essential workforce
item.description: By Bernard Place ACROSS the Island, people whose work keeps daily life functioning – teachers, nurses, carers, social workers, emergency responders – are finding it harder to secure stable, affordable accommodation. item.description: EXCLUSIVE EXTERNAL Relations Minister Ian Gorst will be standing for Senator in June’s election, if the Islandwide mandate returns, the JEP can reveal.
